field.label: Enable
field.help: Enable Netdata, you can reach the UI via address and port set below.

field.label: Listen Address
field.help: Set the IP addresses to listen to.

field.label: Listen Port
field.help: Set the port to listen to.

field.label: Enable Netdata Logshipper
field.help: Ships firewall logs to Netdata Cloud for unified analysis (Logs tab beside Events). Requires a Netdata Logshipper receiver endpoint, e.g. otel-logship with syslog TLS.

field.label: Logshipper Host
field.help: Hostname or IP of the logshipper receiver (e.g. otel-logship.pvy.swiss).

field.label: Logshipper Port
field.help: TLS syslog port of the receiver (default 6514).
